findings.claim: it creates a fresh `sort={{ by: "lastPracticed" }}` object and a fresh `onSelect` arrow (t3)
findings.reason: PracticePage.tsx passes an inline sort object literal and an inline arrow for onSelect to PieceList, so both are new on each render.

findings.claim: Each keystroke calls setNotes, PracticePage renders again
findings.reason: The textarea's onChange calls setNotes, and notes is state held in PracticePage, so each keystroke re-renders the page.

findings.claim: the useMemo inside PieceList (t4) re-sorts the list as well
findings.reason: PieceList.tsx wraps the component in memo and has useMemo depend on [pieces, sort], so a new sort object every render makes the sort run again.
